{"claims":[{"claim_text":"All federally supported infrastructure projects, whether existing or newly developed, financed through grants, loans, tax incentives, or a national infrastructure bank, should create good, union jobs that expand the middle class.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will ensure labor protections, Davis-Bacon wage standards, project labor agreements, collective bargaining neutrality, and domestic sourcing requirements are included in any infrastructure legislation.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will block anti-worker provisions, including forced arbitration.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"As Democrats expand the clean energy technology and infrastructure industry, they will fight to enact legislation that will drive the creation of family sustaining jobs, with the high road labor standards with the provisions defined in the Good Jobs for the 21st Century Energy Act.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support transparent, accountable, and sound management of publicly owned infrastructure and assets.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will ensure that local jurisdictions are adequately protected from partisan power grabs seeking to strip them of publicly owned infrastructure and assets.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will ensure robust federal oversight of any proposed transfers of ownership or operations of publicly owned infrastructure and assets.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will oppose any policy that promotes the privatization of public services or infrastructure.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
